text: The purpose of this report is to request authority to enter into two new non-competitive contracts and to amend multiple non-competitive and competitive Blanket Contracts and Purchase Orders. These Blanket Contract and Purchase Order Amendments are necessary due to the ongoing operational expenses that are required to maintain the shelter system, including providing catering services in temporary shelter sites in hotels, short-term emergency accommodation for refugees and families, a centralized intake system, interpretation services, and maintaining a state of good repair. Suspending any of these services would have significant impacts on the City’s ability to operate the shelter system and to adhere to the Toronto Shelter Standards.
